source: 743 Exploration
target: 743 Exploratio

source: On the dark expanse of the sea, the antiquated Blue Avenger bobbed gently with the undulations of the waves, enveloped by an unending mist.
target: In obscura maris vastitate, vetustus Caeruleus Vindex leniter fluctuum undationibus labebatur, perpetua nebula involutus.

source: Lumian once again came face to face with Alger, the Stormbringer.
target: Lumian iterum occurrit facie ad faciem cum Alger, Tempestatum Afferens.

source: The bearer of The Hanged Man card stood on deck, his deep blue hair a wild mess, seemingly under constant assault from the sea winds.
target: Tabulam “Vir Suspendus” gerens in ponte stetit, capillis eius caeruleis profundis inordinatis, quasi constanti impetu ventorum maris oppugnatis.

source: His attire had changed from his previous sailor’s garb to a captain’s coat adorned with golden embroidery on a blue background.
target: Indumentum eius mutatum est a veteri veste nautarum ad tunicam praefectoriam, quae in caeruleo fundo aurifera insculpta erat.

source: “Explore it yourself,” Alger said to Lumian, who was standing beside Magician, nodding firmly.
target: «Ipse explore,» inquit Alger ad Lumian, qui iuxta Magam statuebatur, firmiter annuens.

source: “I don’t have any wisdom to impart that would help; if I did, I’d have already uncovered all the secrets of this ghost ship.”
target: Nihil sapientiae habeo tribuendae, quae prosit; sin autem haberem, iam omnia arcana huius navis phantasmatis detexissem.

source: These matters had been confirmed by Madam Magician, leaving Lumian without doubts.
target: Haec negotia a Domina Maga confirmata erant, relinquens Lumian sine dubiis.

source: He thanked Alger and began walking forward, his steps echoing on the wooden deck.
target: Alger gratias egit et incedere coepit, passus eius in ponte ligneo resonantes.

source: He triggered the residual aura of the Blood Emperor in his right palm without hesitation, but felt no ominous sensation spill forth.
target: In dextra palma sua, auram residuam Imperatoris Sanguinis activavit, sed nullam sensationem ominosam emanarentem sensit.

source: Instead, his palm felt ice‐cold, while deep within was a pain like fire scorching his flesh.
target: Praeterea, palma eius frigida ut glacies apparebat, et interius dolorem, quasi ignis carnem urens, sentiebat.

source: Lumian lifted his right hand and noticed that the faint red scar had brightened slightly, but the skin covering it had turned paler, more deathlike.
target: Lumian dextram manum levavit et animadvertit cicatricem tenuem rubram leviter fulguisse, sed cutis eam tegens pallidior et mortifera facta esse.

source: I wonder whether the Underworld Daoist’s seal would prevent activating the key special characteristics of this ghost ship… Lumian circled the Blue Avenger’s cabin with a mix of anxiety and trepidation.
target: Me miror num sigillum Daoista Submundi activationem clavorum proprietatum huius navis phantasmatis prohiberet… Lumian cellam Caerulei Vindictoris circumeavit, anxietate et timore mixtis.

source: During his exploration, he encountered no attacks from ropes or any other disturbances.
target: Durante sua exploratione, nullos impetus funium nec alias perturbationes obiit.

source: It seems the residual aura of the Blood Emperor still serves some purpose, or else it wouldn’t be this tranquil… Lumian muttered to himself as he stepped into the cabin, exploring each room in turn.
target: Videtur aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis aliquod finem servare, alioquin non tam tranquilla esset… Lumian se ipsum sussurravit, dum in cellam intrabat et singulas partes explorabat.

source: The Hanged Man, Alger, did not follow but stayed at the front of the deck, watching from afar.
target: Vir Suspendus, Alger, se non secutus est sed in fronte pontis remansit, a longe spectans.

source: As Lumian’s figure disappeared deeper into the ship, Magician raised her right hand and drew a circle in mid‐air with her index finger.
target: Dum figura Lumiani in nave profunde evanuit, Maga dextram manum attollit et indice in aere circulum delineavit.

source: A sprinkle of brilliant starlight emerged, initially forming a transparent crystal orb, then expanding into a circular, dreamlike veil.
target: Exsiluit sparsa splendidae stellae lucis, initio globum crystallinum translucidum formans, deinde in velum circulari, quasi somniculosum, expandens.

source: On the veil, Lumian’s figure appeared, wandering around the captain’s cabin, occasionally extending his right palm to touch various objects.
target: In velamine, figura Lumiani apparuit, circa cellam capitanei vagans, interdum dextram palmam extendens ad varia tangenda.

source: “There should be some findings,” Magician stated with a charlatan‐like tone.
target: «Inventa nonnulla esse debent,» inquit Maga, tono charlatanico.

source: The Hanged Man nodded slightly, not asking what might be found or what changes it could bring, since even Magician could not divine a certain future, and Ma’am Hermit could only see vague images.
target: Vir Suspendus leviter annuit, nec quaesivit quid reperiri posset aut quae mutationes afferre, cum etiam Maga futurum certum divinare non posset, atque Domina Eremita tantum imagines vagas videre valeat.

source: After Mr. Fool’s slumber, the Major Arcana card holders had explored the Blue Avenger multiple times but had not unraveled the ghost ship’s core secrets or located the treasures left by the Tudor dynasty.
target: Post somnum Domini Stulti, habentes cartas Maioris Arcanae, multoties Caeruleum Vindictorem exploraverant, sed nec arcana nuclei huius navis phantasmatis detexere nec thesauros a dynastia Tudor relictos invenire potuerant.

source: With the Apprentice pathway’s speciality, Magician only managed to help The Hanged Man uncover other secrets, unable to reach the deepest level.
target: Per specialitatem viae discipulorum, Maga tantum valuit Viro Suspenduto alia arcana detegere, neque ad gradum maximum pervenire potuisse.

source: Mr. Star’s explanation was:
target: Explicatio Domini Star erat:

source: “The Blue Avenger is not only influenced by the Lawyer pathway’s Distortion authority but also possesses notable traits of errors, spatial transposition, and grafting.
target: Caeruleus Vindex non solum ab auctoritate distortionis viae Advocati afficitur, sed etiam insignia errorum, transpositionis spatialis, et insertionis notabilia possidet.

source: And this aligned with the actual circumstances of the Tudor dynasty: Under Blood Emperor Alista Tudor, among the five great nobles, Amon was the Marauder, the King of Angels of the Error pathway, later becoming a true god; the ancestor of the Abraham family, Mr. Door, was the King of Angels of the Apprentice pathway; and the ancestor of the Antigonus family was the King of Angels of the Seer pathway. The Jacob and Tamara families had one Angel from the Error pathway and one who had been an Angel of the Apprentice pathway.
target: Et hoc conveniebat cum circumstantiis veris dynastiae Tudor: sub Imperatore Sanguinis Alista Tudor, inter quinque magnos nobilissimos, Amon erat Praedator, Angelorum Rex viae Erroris, postea verus deus factus; maior familiae Abraham, Dominus Door, erat Angelorum Rex viae Discipulorum; et maior familiae Antigoni erat Angelorum Rex viae Videntis. Familiae Iacob et Tamara unum Angelum ex via Erroris et unum, qui Angelus viae Discipulorum fuisset, habebant.

source: They clearly possessed strong abilities to utilize errors, alter positions, and graft spaces.
target: Illi manifeste validas facultates habebant ad errores utendi, positiones mutandi, et spatia inserendi.

source: If not ensuring the preservation of the Blue Avenger and its treasures unharmed and intact, Magician felt she could unravel the ghost ship’s deepest secrets, but doing so would reduce the Blue Avenger to irreparable fragments.
target: Nisi Caeruleus Vindex et thesauri eius intacti et integri servarentur, Maga arbitrabatur se posse arcana profunda huius navis phantasmatis detegere, sed hoc faciendo Caeruleus Vindex in fragmenta irreparabilia redigeretur.

source: Under the watchful eyes of two Major Arcana card holders, Lumian searched every room on the upper deck without triggering any anomalies.
target: Sub oculis vigilantibus duorum tenentium cartarum Maioris Arcanae, Lumian omnem cellam in ponte superiore perlustrare coepit, sine ullis anomalis provocatis.

source: He intermittently came across seven or eight sailors, all instructed by the captain not to interfere with his exploration.
target: Intervallis invenit septem aut octo nautas, omnes a capitan instructos ne eius explorationi immiscere.

source: Approaching the stairs leading up to the lower decks, Lumian glanced down into the pitch‐black abyss below, maintaining the stimulated aura of the Blood Emperor as he descended the creaking stairs.
target: Accedens ad scalas inferiores pontis, Lumian in abyssum totum atrum sub se conspexit, servans excitatam auram Imperatoris Sanguinis, dum scalas crepitantes descendebat.

source: As he walked, he suddenly detected an unusual scent.
target: Dum ambulabat, subito odor insolitum sensit.

source: He had been descending for thirty to forty seconds, which under normal circumstances should have brought him to the lower deck’s floor.
target: Iam per triginta ad quadraginta secundas descendebat, quod sub ordinariis circumstantiis eum ad solum pontis inferioris attulisset.

source: The distance between the Blue Avenger’s upper and lower decks couldn’t possibly be so vast that a Reaper couldn’t traverse it in dozens of seconds!
target: Inter stratum superius et inferius Caerulei Vindictoris spatium nequaquam tam ingens esse potuit, ut Messor in paucis secundis transire non posset!

source: To this, Lumian responded not with alarm, but with elation.
target: Ad hoc, Lumian nec cum metu sed cum laetitia respondit.

source: An anomaly was exactly what he needed!
target: Vere, anomalia erat ea quae ei opus erat!

source: Had there been no anomaly, it would have meant the sealed residual aura of the Blood Emperor could no longer function properly!
target: Si anomalia non esset, id significaret auram residuam clausam Imperatoris Sanguinis iam non recte functionare posse!

source: Lumian exhaled, calming his nerves while maintaining a steady but unhurried pace, continuing the creaking descent into the darkness.
target: Lumian exhalavit, nervos suos leniens, dum gradu constanti sed non festinante servabat, descensum crepitantem in tenebras continuans.

source: After an indeterminate amount of time, he saw no more wooden steps ahead; his feet now touched cold, black stone slabs radiating a metallic chill.
target: Post indefinitum tempus, non apparuerunt ulteriores gradus lignei; pedes eius iam continebant laminae lapideae frigidae, nigrae, metallo splendentes.

source: Have I arrived? Just as this thought flickered through Lumian’s mind, his vision was flooded with blazing white light.
target: Advenione? Juste cum haec cogitatio in mentem Lumiani intravit, visio eius luce alba ardenti inundata est.

source: He saw a barrage of white‐hot flame spears flying densely toward him, obscuring everything above.
target: Vidit impetum hastarum flammarum candentium, densissime in se volitantium, quae omnia super obscurabant.

source: It was like facing an army, each soldier hurling a flame spear from their hands.
target: Erant quasi contra exercitum, cum quisque miles hastam ignis ex manibus iactaret.

source: There was nowhere to hide, no way to dodge.
target: Nusquam celari possis, nec viam evadendi inveniretur.

source: Instinctively, Lumian was about to swap places with his shadow, hoping to use this rapid ability to survive the initial volley and then seek a chance to teleport away.
target: Instinctive, Lumian paene se cum umbra sua commutare volebat, sperans hanc celerem facultatem ad primam iactationem superandam atque deinde ad occasionem se translocandi quaerendam.

source: But just then, he had an idea—an extremely daring idea.
target: Sed eo tempore, ideam habuit—ideam egregie audacem.

source: Lumian’s expression took on a tinge of madness as he faced the overwhelming barrage of flame spears, not using any abilities and not even attempting to dodge.
target: Vultus Lumiani ad modum insaniae vertus mutatus est, dum adversus vastum impetum hastarum flammarum se contendebat, sine ulla facultate aut conatu evadendi.

source: He straightened his back and thrust forward his right palm.
target: Dorsum recte sustulit et palmam dextram in ante protulit.

source: The right palm, sealed by the Underworld Daoist and carrying the residual aura of the Blood Emperor—both were fully activated.
target: Palma dextra, ab Daoista Submundi sigillata et auram residuam Imperatoris Sanguinis ferens, ambo plene activata erant.

source: The dense, rain‐like barrage of white‐hot flame spears instantly froze in mid‐air.
target: Densa, quasi pluvia, impetu hastarum flammarum candentium statim in aere congelata est.

source: They stopped, neither advancing nor falling.
target: Statuerunt, neque procedentes neque cadentes.

source: Seeing this, Lumian let out an uncontrollable sigh of relief.
target: Hoc videns, Lumian suspirum ineluctabilem levationis emittere coepit.

source: He had made the right bet!
target: Bene iudicaverat!

source: Gradually, the white‐hot flame spears began to extinguish, slowly fading until they completely disappeared.
target: Paulatim, impetu hastarum flammarum candentium exstinguere coepit, lente evanescentes, donec omnino evanuerunt.

source: Before Lumian could take a closer look, clusters of bright flames lit up on both sides.
target: Antequam Lumian propius inspicere posset, congeries flammarum nitidarum utrinque accensae sunt.

source: They resembled wall‐mounted lamps, piercing the dense darkness and revealing the surroundings.
target: Instar lampadarum in parietes fixarum apparuerunt, tenebras densas perforantes et cuncta circumstantia revelantes.

source: He found himself in a deep, wide hall that was smaller than he had imagined.
target: Inveni se in aula profunda et lata, quae parva videbatur comparata cum eius expectatione.

source: When the white‐hot flame spears were hurled at him like a flock of endless crows, it felt as though he stood on an ancient battlefield, vast enough to be measured in kilometers. However, the hall before him was merely the size of the grand prayer hall of the Saint Vive Cathedral.
target: Cum hastae flammarum candentes in eum iactabantur instar turbae incessabilium corvorum, sensus erat quasi in antiquo campo proelii steteret, vasto ut chiliometris metiri posset; attamen aula ante eum solum erat magnitudinis aulae magnae orationis Ecclesiae Sancti Vive.

source: At a glance, Lumian’s gaze froze, and his heart seemed to stop beating.
target: In uno intuitu, conspectus Lumiani congelatus est, et cor eius quasi cessare pulsare videbatur.

source: At the far end of the hall, there stood a colossal throne made of black iron.
target: In extremo aulae, stabat thronus colossalis ex ferro nigro confectus.

source: The surface of the throne bore patches of red, either from the corrosion of ages or from old bloodstains.
target: Superficies throni maculas rubras gerebat, sive ex corrosionis temporum sive ex veteribus sanguinis vestigiis.

source: There was a figure on the throne!
target: In trono erat figura!

source: This figure was giant‐like, draped in a deep red ceremonial robe and wearing an iron‐black crown, with its right elbow resting on the armrest, supporting its bowed head.
target: Haec figura similis gigante erat, in profunda rubra vestimenta caerimonia induta et coronam ex ferro nigro gerens, cum cubito dextro in subsidio reposito, caput inclinatum sustinens.

source: The flickering blood‐red long hair draped down, hiding the figure’s face.
target: Longi capilli rubro‐sanguinei, micantes, deferebantur, figuram occultantes.

source: Lumian was familiar with this figure; he had seen it at the Samaritan Women’s Spring, though the attire was somewhat different now.
target: Lumian huic figurae nota erat; eam vidit ad Fons Feminarum Samaritanarum, quamquam indumentum nunc aliquantum differebat.

source: It was the figure of Blood Emperor Alista Tudor!
target: Haec erat figura Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor!

source: However, this figure lacked the terror, violence, and madness seen at the Samaritan Women’s Spring, devoid of the aura of war and destruction, and the tangible oppressiveness and sense of conquest; if it weren’t visible, Lumian would have believed there was nothing on the iron throne.
target: Tamen, haec figura caret timore, violentia, et insania, qualia ad Fons Feminarum Samaritanarum visa erant, nec auram belli et exitii, neque veram oppressivitatem ac sensum subjugationis; si non apparuisset, Lumian credidisset in trono ferreo nihil esse.

source: A phantom? Lumian closed his eyes, relying solely on his other senses and intuition to feel.
target: Phantasma? Lumian oculos clauserat, solum aliis sensibus et intuitu innixus ad percipiendum.

source: In this perception, there was nothing above the iron throne marked with red stains.
target: In hac perceptione, nihil super trono ferreo, rubris maculis signatum, apparebat.

source: Lumian’s heartbeat gradually normalized, and he reopened his eyes to look at the iron throne.
target: Pulsus cordis Lumiani paulatim se normalizavit, atque oculos rediens thronum ferreum contemplari coepit.

source: The figure remained motionless.
target: Figura immota permanebat.

source: Lumian resisted the urge to observe any weaknesses in the figure or to activate the Eye of Calamity. Instead, he shifted his gaze and surveyed the rest of the hall.
target: Lumian repugnare conatus est desiderium observandi infirmitates figurae aut Oculus Calamitatis activandi; pro eo, oculos suos verteret et reliquam aulae partem perlustrare coepit.

source: Below the nine steps leading up to the iron throne were five mottled stone chairs—two on the left and three on the right.
target: Sub novem gradibus ad thronum ferreum ducientibus, erant quinque cathedrae lapideae maculatae – duae ad sinistram et tres ad dextram.

source: Why couldn’t there be one more, for symmetry? Lumian couldn’t help but criticize to himself.
target: Cur non esset una adhuc ad symmetriam? Lumian se ipse non potuit non reprehendere.

source: He knew these five stone chairs likely represented the five great nobles of the Tudor dynasty.
target: Sciebat has quinque cathedras lapideas probabiliter repraesentare quinque magnos nobilissimos dynastiae Tudor.

source: These ancient, mottled chairs appeared smashed by someone; some were completely split by cracks, some shattered into countless pieces yet barely holding their original shape, some had broken backrests, some were missing their seats, and others seemed melted by intense flames as if burnt for a long time.
target: Hae antiqui, maculatae cathedrae videbantur ab aliquo percussae esse; quaedam fissis, quaedam in innumerabilia fragmenta dissipata, vix formam originariam retinentes, quaedam tergo fracto habentes, quaedam sellas carentes, et aliae intensis flammarum liquefactae quasi diu ustulatae apparuerunt.

source: Had there been a battle here? Lumian tried to find corresponding marks on the black stone floor, the giant supporting columns, and the surrounding walls, but found nothing.
target: Pugna hic orta fuit? Lumian conatus est vestigia correspondens invenire in pavimento lapideo nigro, columnis ingentibus sustentantibus, et parietibus circumstantiis, sed nihil repertum est.

source: No objects either… Weren’t there supposed to be treasures from the Tudor dynasty hidden here? Had they been stolen? Hmm, Termiboros had said earlier that if I’m not of high enough level, forcibly exploring the Blue Avenger could lead to the resurrection of Alista Tudor within me… This suggests there should be something here, or some arrangement… Lumian started walking forward again.
target: Nec obiecta quoque… Nonne thesauri dynastiae Tudor hic celandi erant? Furti illi fuerunt? Hmm, Termiboros antea dixit, quod, nisi gradus meus satis altus esset, exploratio vi Caerulei Vindictoris ad resurrectionem Alista Tudor in me ducere posset… Id indicat aliquid hic esse, aut aliquam dispositionem; Lumian iterum incedere coepit.

source: All the while, he kept his eyes on the figure on the iron throne, observing every detail.
target: Omni tempore, oculos suos in figura in trono ferreo retinuit, singula diligenter observans.

source: Suddenly, he saw a pair of eyes, iron‐black and cold.
target: Subito, vidit par oculorum, nigra et frigida.

source: The figure on the iron throne slowly raised its head.
target: Figura in trono ferreo caput paulatim attollit.
